WHERE protocol_jobs.run_id IN (?)

SELECT events.run_id 
FROM events 
WHERE events.run_id IN (?) AND events.kind = ?

SELECT "private_read_runs".id 
FROM "private_read_runs" 
WHERE "private_read_runs".id IN (?) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT anon_1."key" 
FROM json_each(CASE WHEN (json_type("private_read_runs".context) = ?) THEN "private_read_runs".context ELSE ? END) AS anon_1 
WHERE anon_1."key" = ? AND anon_1.type = ? AND anon_1.value = ?)) OR (EXISTS (SELECT anon_2."key" 
FROM json_each(CASE WHEN (json_type("private_read_runs".result) = ?) THEN "private_read_runs".result ELSE ? END) AS anon_3 JOIN json_each(CASE WHEN (anon_3.type = ?) THEN anon_3.value ELSE ? END) AS anon_2 ON 1 = 1 
WHERE anon_3."key" = ? AND anon_2."key" = ? AND anon_2.type = ? AND anon_2.value = ?)))

SELECT "private_read_run_contracts".run_id, "private_read_run_contracts".snapshot, "private_read_run_contracts".fingerprint 
FROM "private_read_run_contracts" 
WHERE "private_read_run_contracts".run_id IN (?) AND (EXISTS (SELECT anon_1."key" 
FROM json_each(CASE WHEN (json_type("private_read_run_contracts".snapshot) = ?) THEN "private_read_run_contracts".snapshot ELSE ? END) AS anon_2 JOIN json_each(CASE WHEN (anon_2.type = ?) THEN anon_2.value ELSE ? END) AS anon_3 ON 1 = 1 JOIN json_each(CASE WHEN (anon_3.type = ?) THEN anon_3.value ELSE ? END) AS anon_1 ON 1 = 1 
WHERE anon_2."key" = ? AND anon_3."key" = ? AND anon_1.type = ? AND anon_1.value = ?))

SELECT attempts.id, attempts.run_id, attempts.created_at, attempts.mode, attempts.request_model, attempts.response_model, attempts.status, attempts.usage, attempts.reserved_tokens, attempts.parameters, attempts.response, attempts.error, attempts.elapsed 
FROM attempts 
WHERE attempts.run_id IN (?)
